$comment: Screenplay's TypeScript lives in the Yarn workspaces under Source/ (screenplay-language, screenplay-editor, VSCodeExtension).
Only changes there trigger the frontend gates; managed .cratis/ai updates contain .ts files that are not part of the product (Cratis/AI#430).

There is no g:compile script. The compile gate type-checks the language package (specs included), builds it, and type-checks the VS Code extension against it: the extension's publish build (esbuild) does not type-check.
screenplay-editor has no separate type-check in CI and has pre-existing errors, so it is not compiled here.

command: yarn workspace @cratis/screenplay-language compile && yarn workspace @cratis/screenplay-language build && yarn workspace screenplay typecheck
